scientific_question: Does a native downstream flow objective expose error transport/cancellation absent from independent per-FFN gated SSE at a fixed adjacent pair?
substantive_change: Four-arm intervention at two distinct layers, with full downstream native flow and cross-layer interaction; no support search, larger q/rank or relabeled local reconstruction.
position_choice: Fix block30 from the prior LR1 late-layer control and its immediate successor before any new transport outcomes; no search over pairs. This remains a development-informed choice.

inputs.source: Same4 original TF2 development-exposed inputs; original image/prompt/seed/config and complete conditioning preserved
inputs.state: Original D-Q per-step input, same native scheduler/RNG/cache state in every arm; never claim teacher-forced video quality

arms.none: Frozen UB1 everywhere, required to reproduce saved TF2 native input/flow/post tensors
arms.A: Replace only A pre-gate FFN output by full original native same-input D-Q FFN output; preserve current gate and all remaining computation
arms.B: Replace only B by its same-input native full output; B sees the actual current arm input
arms.AB: Replace A andB, recomputing B on A-intervened downstream input, no resetting inside the block pair

measurements: Original FP64 gated local FFN SSE at both positions on each arm's actual input
FP64 full flow SSE to the matched original D-Q flow
Full operand SHA, repeated none noise floor, per-source results and all failed controls
falsifiable_prediction: Independent local error magnitude may mis-rank downstream restoration benefit, with direction/cross-layer terms exceeding native numerical noise. It is not yet observed. R4E1 same-layer group interactions do not measure this quantity.
decision_rule: If the scoped pair has no resolved target-ranking difference or interaction, do not promote its joint-recovery hypothesis. A difference motivates a separately registered window-output objective test, not automatic training, candidate quality acceptance or widening the pair search.
cost_and_stop: Exactly12 control generations (4 DQ identity,4 observed none,4 repeated none), then12 interventions (4 each A/B/AB); every generation executes all4 native steps. Stop on first failed control. Preserve failures; code repairs require a separately frozen attempt, never overwrite. No final-step resume shortcut or source/pair/threshold sweep.
data_exposure: All original TF2 sources and both old20 quality cohorts are development-exposed; this is causal diagnosis only. New training/validation/final sources would be frozen separately.
deployment_contract: No change:50% main MAC, complete FFN>=1.5x including every auxiliary operation, independent fresh-source official aesthetic/imaging/motion drops each<=2%.

execution_plan.storage: HF derived cache; preserve80GiB node reserve plus2GiB run allowance
execution_plan.selection: Fixed diagnostic only; no training, support/pair/seed/rank search, no quality or speed acceptance

control_resolution: Reviewed implementation uses original full native TeacherRecords.apply on current norm input/raw biases; dense identity tests both selected positions, all4 full flow/input/post hashes are checked against original TF2, selected FFNs must leave RNG unchanged. Scientific controls remain pending and must pass before interventions.
required_controls_before_selection: Implement/review hook; bind original weights, biases, Smooth/QDQ/GELU/cast, fullM geometry and frozen UB1 policy
Unmodified observer and none arm reproduce all4 original TF2 inputs/flows/post tensors bitwise
No mutation of shared cache/conditioning/RNG; pair activation inputs and pre-gate writeback bound independently
Selected local full teacher reproduces unmodified dense FFN on an identity control at the same input
Record that dense interventions violate candidate main-MAC budget and are diagnostic only
model_execution_scope: Registration permits controls only initially. Runtime requires complete matching DQ/none/repeated-none certificates before any intervention; registration is not a positive scientific result.
